title: Recipe
description: A straightforward, no-fuss vegan quick bread that's moist, delicious, and refreshingly simple. No data harvesting, just great taste.
name: The Un-Meta Quick Zucchini Bread

dry.name: Granulated sugar
dry.notes: Use a vegan-certified brand if needed

wet.name: Zucchini
wet.notes: Grated and lightly packed. Do not squeeze dry.

wet.name: Neutral oil
wet.notes: Such as canola or vegetable oil

instructions.description: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
In a small bowl, whisk together the ground flaxseed and water. Set aside for 5-10 minutes to thicken into a gel-like 'flax egg'.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients: all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
To the bowl with the thickened flax egg, add the neutral oil, and vanilla extract. Whisk to combine. Then, stir in the grated zucchini.
Pour the wet ingredients into the bowl of dry ingredients. Stir with a spatula until just combined. Do not overmix; a few lumps are perfectly fine.
If using, gently fold in the chopped walnuts or vegan chocolate chips.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and spread it into an even layer.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a wooden skewer or toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean.
Let the bread cool in the pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes before carefully removing it from the pan. Let it cool completely on the rack before slicing.

notes: For best results, do not squeeze the water out of the grated zucchini; its moisture is key to a tender loaf. The bread is best once fully cooled, as it allows the structure to set properly. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
